decision_rationale: The record presents a new framework, CELLama, for scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It explicitly transforms cell data into sentences and embeds cellular metadata, supporting a substantive text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “developed CELLama ... transform cell data into ‘sentences’ that encapsulate gene expressions and metadata”; “transforming gene expression data ... into a structured textual format”
